dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, pale edges (high grayscale contrast) clearly demarcating the boundaries of folded primary and secondary flight feathers against dark brown feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: High distinctness transition separating the uniform brown-textured nape and crown from the dark-centered, pale-fringed scaled plumage of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Dark loral/orbital patch forming a partial mask and a stout, pale bluish-grey beak.
